Hi, Ms. Stewart.
This is Pedro.
I take care of Mr. Molina's scheduling.
I'm calling because Mr. Molina was scheduled to return from an international business trip on Friday and then meet with you the following day.
The thing is, though, his trip has been extended by one day.
Please give me a call. and extended by one day.
Please give me a call back or stop by my office so we can discuss other options.
I'll be at my desk the rest of the afternoon.
context.transcript_translation:
嗨，Stewart女士。
我是Pedro。
我负责Molina先生的日程安排。
我打电话是因为Molina先生原定于周五结束一次国际商务旅行，并在接下来的日子与您会面。
但问题是，他的行程延长了一天。
请给我回电话，或者到我的办公室来，这样我们可以讨论其他选择。
我今天下午剩下的时间都在我的办公桌前。
